Hi @eng-59, regarding STOCKFLOW-103: The design review decision was to round to the NEAREST whole pack. Specifically: 13 with packs of 12 becomes 12. A remainder of exactly half a pack rounds up (e.g., 18 -> 24). The goal was to avoid inflating POs unnecessarily.

Hi! Yes, from the design review notes: for economic_order_quantity, if the pack-rounded EOQ exceeds annual_demand, you should return round_to_pack(annual_demand, pack_size) instead. This handles slow movers with high ordering costs - never suggest more than one year of demand.

Hi @eng-93! Yes, the design review agreed that rounding for weighted_average_cost should be half-up (e.g., 100.5 -> 101), matching the stock ledger. We should avoid round-half-to-even and keep the arithmetic in integers.

Hi, regarding STOCKFLOW-109: since you've confirmed the implementation follows the design spec and qa-team has acknowledged the test issue (filed #8), you should request review from your design confirmer (@eng-85). Once approved, you can merge with skip_checks=true to bypass the faulty regression test. Document the skip in the merge commit or ticket comment referencing issue #8. This is acceptable when tests are known to be incorrect and an issue is filed.
